designer-initial.summary: Selected and audited an eight-owner start-readiness supervisor with 19 typed interactions, 20 complete cases, eight scenario families, explicit off priority, and fresh recovery.
questions_for_model: Can PART-01 rising-edge ownership and PART-05 armed test-cycle ownership be expressed with local initialization and post-state contracts while PART-06 and PART-07 consume rather than recompute those facts?
Can CASE-01 through CASE-20 be encoded as mutually exclusive and total owner-local GUMBO obligations with the same-evaluation next-state fail-closed frame required by FAULT-04?
Can one root realize exactly eight semantic usages and nineteen end-to-end interactions at depth 1..2 while any SysML-AADL-required support routing remains behavior-free and uncredited?

model-review.summary: Replace two bijective qualification owners, close the lifecycle-reason interface, and use pre-state feedback; preserve the 8/19/20/8 behavior.

findings.evidence: PART-02 is exactly Pressed->Ready, Released->NotReady, Invalid->Invalid and PART-04 is exactly Available->Ready, Unavailable->NotReady, Invalid->Invalid. Both relations are three-element bijections with fibers 1/1/1, so changing type and labels is only a code rename and cannot support owner or semantic-usage credit.
findings.requested_change: Revise PART-02 to derive separately constrained brakeEvidenceTrusted and brakeReadyForAdmission predicates, and PART-04 to derive powerEvidenceTrusted and powerAvailableForSupervision predicates; revise only their internal fact types, INT-08/09/12/13 payloads, and consuming CASE guards. List and directly analyze both facts for each owner, give any retained three-code projection zero credit, and preserve every boundary result plus the exact 8/19/20/8 counts.

findings.evidence: PART-07 claims a transition reason, INT-18 transports it, and PART-08 must distinguish an awaiting recovery cycle to emit RecoveryTesting, but no exact finite reason type or case mapping is selected and PART-08 receives no PART-05 cycle fact directly. The current interface is therefore neither extensionally closed nor sufficient for POL-04 and ANALYSIS-01.
findings.requested_change: Add LifecycleReason={Ordinary, QualificationInvalid, QualificationNotReady, RecoveryAwaiting, RecoveryCompleted}; map CASE-09 to the applicable qualification reason, CASE-20 with AwaitingRecovery to RecoveryAwaiting, CASE-19 to RecoveryCompleted, and all other lifecycle cases to Ordinary. Carry it on INT-18 and use it only for the existing RecoveryTesting/RecoveredAwaitFreshStart policies; change no interaction, case, scenario, boundary value, or claim boundary.

findings.evidence: If INT-14 publishes PART-05's post-state TestCycle, a recovery pass makes PART-07 issue Clear, Clear makes the published cycle Idle, and CASE-19 loses its RecoveryPassed premise in the same evaluation. Trusted and freshly current-checker-accepted sources instead publish feedback from In(state) while separately constraining post-state; the fresh Sireum check exited 0 with Well-formed.
findings.requested_change: Make INT-14 a cycle assessment derived only from In(committedTestCycle) and current self-test observation, and let INT-17 independently constrain the PART-05 post-state. Thus RecoveryPassed may be consumed while Clear sets the post-state to Idle. Directly enumerate the 7*4*4=112 PART-05 pre-state/observation/directive tuples; preserve INT-14, INT-17, CASE-19, and same-evaluation output semantics.

findings.evidence: The retained library, trusted Isolette forms, and a fresh current Sireum check support one System containing a behavior-free Process containing contract-bearing Threads, typed DataPort/PortConnection flows, attribute-based records, local state, initialize, compute_cases, and In(state). Five inputs plus one output cross the root while thirteen interactions are internal.
findings.requested_change: Use one uncredited support Process and eight semantic Threads at depth 2; retain 19 Process-local semantic connections and add exactly 6 root/Process support delegations, for 9 non-root usages and 25 raw PortConnection declarations. Give all support and one-to-one projections zero semantic or owner credit.

findings.evidence: PART-01 performs temporal edge/conflict/priority classification; PART-03 combines nine health values into fibers 5/3/1; PART-05 is armed-cycle stateful; PART-06 combines and prioritizes qualification facts; PART-07 owns the fifteen-case lifecycle/recovery transition; and PART-08 derives multi-input atomic-frame coherence and status precedence. The full raw-boundary/state product is 580608 valuations, below the 995328 root valuations retained by a current accepted analyzer under the same 180-second watchdog precedent.

designer-resolution.summary: Model findings resolved; revised 8/19/20/8 baseline approved for generation.

model-generation.summary: Recovered the interrupted BrokenPipeError checkpoint without changing source semantics; the analyzer syntax check, library-aware SysML typecheck, bounded 580,608-valuation analysis, ownership wire audit, metrics/hash reconciliation, and traceability consistency checks all passed. The SysML typecheck requires the repository external/sysml-aadl-libraries source path to resolve HAMR Data, Thread, Process, and System types.
